title.en: Watching the Snow from the Mid-Lake Pavilion

year_display.zh: 写于 1644 年之后；1775 年初刊

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (Tao’an mengyi, book 3).
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《陶庵梦忆》卷三）。

basis.en: Late Ming prose; the author died in the late 17th century, and the work was first printed in 1775.
basis.zh: 明末散文，作者卒于 17 世纪末，此书 1775 年初刊。

note.en: Zhang Dai’s recollection of a snowy night on West Lake in the winter of 1632–33, written after the fall of the Ming and printed long after his death. The whole lake is reduced to a stroke, a dot, a mustard seed and two or three grains. It belongs in a library that keeps snow and lamps: a small stove, warm wine, and strangers who turn out to be kindred.
note.zh: 张岱追记崇祯五年（1632）冬西湖的一个雪夜，写于明亡之后，刊行时他已去世多年。整个湖被写成一痕、一点、一芥和两三粒。它属于这座收藏雪与灯的图书馆：一炉火，一壶热酒，萍水相逢却气味相投的人。

excerpt.orig: 湖上影子，惟長堤一痕，湖心亭一點，與余舟一芥，舟中人兩三粒而已。
excerpt.en: The only shadows on the lake were a single stroke, the long causeway; a single dot, the mid-lake pavilion; my boat, a mustard seed; and the people in it, two or three grains.
excerpt.zh: 湖上影子，惟长堤一痕，湖心亭一点，与余舟一芥，舟中人两三粒而已。

gloss.en: The twelfth lunar month of Chongzhen 5, in the winter of 1632–33. Chongzhen was the last reign of the Ming.
gloss.zh: 崇祯五年十二月，约当公元 1633 年初。崇祯，明朝最后一个年号。

gloss.en: After the first watch of the night had been drummed, about eight in the evening.
To pole or row a boat.
A pavilion on a small island in the middle of the West Lake, first built in 1552.
gloss.zh: 西湖中小岛上的亭子，始建于明嘉靖三十一年（1552）。

gloss.en: 霧凇 is hoarfrost, 沆碭 a white vapour spread everywhere.
gloss.zh: 雾凇，雾气凝成的冰花；沆砀，白气弥漫的样子。

gloss.en: The long causeway across the lake, usually taken to be the Su Causeway, shows as a single stroke.
gloss.zh: 长堤，一般认为指苏堤。一痕，一道淡淡的痕迹。

gloss.en: A mustard seed: the smallest of things.
gloss.zh: 芥，小草或芥子，比喻极小。

gloss.en: 白 is a large wine cup: three big cups.
A polite term for a gentleman: ‘the master’, ‘sir’.
Mad, besotted: in late Ming taste an obsession was a mark of a person worth knowing. Zhang Dai wrote that one cannot befriend someone without a passion.
gloss.zh: 痴迷。晚明文人以“痴”“癖”为真性情，张岱说过“人无癖不可与交”。
